product.name: Monoprice USB-A to USB-C Adapter
product.description: Connect your device with a USB-A connector to a USB-C® port using this USB-A to USB-C Adapter from Monoprice™!This small adapter features a standard female USB-A port and male USB-C plug. It allows you to use an existing USB 2.0 or 3.0 device, such as a mouse, USB hub, etc., with a USB-C connector port, such as that found on the newest MacBook Air®. Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
